theorem: All inhomogeneous deformations parameterized by gb_{sigma, j, s} for C(n+1) are trivial up to a scalar central extension.
justification: The cocycle gamma_gb is exactly a coboundary delta f modulo scalars. Computations for n=1 and n=2 reveal that the left null space of the linear system A*f = gamma imposes zero constraints on the parameters gb, implying that a valid odd linear map f always exists for any gb.
